dashboard.noPeriodicPlugin: Daily Notes or Periodic Notes plugin is required

settings.title: Obsidian Widgets
settings.languageDesc: Language used for widget labels. 'Auto' follows Obsidian's language setting.
settings.latitudeDesc: Default latitude used when a widget does not specify its own.
settings.longitudeDesc: Default longitude used when a widget does not specify its own.
settings.locationDesc: Display name shown in the weather card (optional).
settings.unitsDesc: Default unit used when a widget does not specify its own.
settings.tagColorsDesc: Map note tags to colored dots shown under each day in the monthly widget.
settings.linkColorsDesc: Map note links to colored dots shown under each day in the monthly widget. Enter the filename without extension.
